text:
emma: HelixCore requested a compact perf/W + throughput run next week for marketplace onboarding and a short joint notes pack. Scope: steady-state perf/W curve, p95/p99 throughput, and kernel tuning artifacts.

jared: Do they expose PDU metering and perfmon? How many rigs? Which model shapes?

leo-helixcore: We can open VPN + perfmon on rigs H1-H3 by Tue EOD. PDU metering available at 1s resolution. Suggested model: redwood-micro (512/2048).

priya: Test matrix proposal: modes=fp16,int8,q4_0; kernels=stock,fused-attn,cublas-tuned; powercaps 300/250/200W. Include KV-cache thrash, sustained 45m steady-state windows, and quick regen spot-checks.

nate: Telemetry minimum: run_id, ts, host_pdu_w(1s), socket_w, gpu_power_w, p50/p95/p99 latency, ipc, l2_miss. We'll store aggregated CSVs + PNGs; raw traces require NDA addendum. Sample schema below.

emma: Paste schema? I'll add to partner onboarding doc.

nate: ```json
{"run_id":"bench-1825554321","ts":1825554321,"host_pdu_w":215.6,"socket_w":[107.8,107.6],"gpu_power_w":200.3,"latency_ms":{"p50":9.8,"p95":42.0,"p99":78.4},"counters":{"ipc":0.81,"l2_miss":0.009},"notes":"driver=535.86,cuda=12.1"}
```

emma: Owners: Jared=bench ops; Priya=kernel tuning; Nate=telemetry & analysis; Emma=PM/announce. Agree?

jared: Agreed. I'll run dry-run Wed, tuning Thu, final sweep Fri if VPN up. Need Helix to enable perfmon and kernel debug symbols.

bench-bot: Run scheduled: id=bench-1825554321 -> start=1825630800. Modes queued: fp16,int8,q4_0.

priya: Pin driver/stack in logs: nvidia-driver 535.86 / CUDA 12.1 / cuBLAS 12.1. For tuned runs we'll try ATTEN_FUSE=1 and CUBLAS_TUNE=3. Add quality gate: token logprob delta vs baseline >0.5 flags manual review.

leo-helixcore: H1/H2 can match stack; H3 is on older driver and will be marked in matrix. I'll enable VPN Tue AM and start the NDA flow for raw dumps.

emma: Runner snippet for bench ops:
```bash
run-bench --model redwood-micro --seq 2048 --modes fp16,int8,q4_0 \
  --dur 2700 --powercaps 300,250,200 \
  --telemetry s3://redwood-partner-helixcore/bench-1825554321 \
  --rigs H1,H2,H3
```

legal-bot: Raw kernel traces considered sensitive. NDA addendum recommended before sharing; aggregated CSVs and figures OK without addendum.

emma: Action items: 1) Leo enable VPN+perfmon Tue AM. 2) Jared prepare harness + Console dashboard. 3) Priya supply tuning knobs + safe defaults. 4) Nate create telemetry bucket and ingest rules. 5) Emma open NDA addendum with Legal and draft embargoed figure pack.

jared: I'll post dry-run dashboard link after Wed. Thanks all! :rocket:
